ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.desc: The starting hero: a precise hunter with high crit, natural evasion and a devastating four-arrow ultimate.

ultimate.name: Arrow Storm
ultimate.desc: Four rapid arrows dealing roughly 340% total damage to the entire pack.

ranger.scaleNotes: Attack is the core stat; Crit is unusually valuable because Ranger starts high and Arrow Storm scales directly from Attack. Echo adds more independent arrows between ultimates, while Dodge keeps the glassier hunter alive.

passive.name: Marked Quarry
passive.desc: Basic attacks mark their target up to 3 times. Each mark adds Crit against that target; Arrow Storm consumes all marks for extra damage.

sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
sorcerer.desc: An occult spellcaster with a real Mana cycle. Channel Bolt builds Mana; Arcane Lance spends it on a Crit-capable spell that converts half of Echo chance into bonus damage, applies Echo-weighted Poison, Lifesteal, and guarantees a random core-element eruption. Sorcerer's Signature Burst is Arcane Surge: when it procs, that basic or Echo strike deals 50% more damage.

ultimate.name: Starfall
ultimate.desc: A 300% meteor that strikes the entire pack and restores 20% of damage dealt.

sorcerer.scaleNotes: Attack powers both Channel Bolt and Arcane Lance. Arcane Lance can Crit, converts half of Echo chance into bonus spell damage, applies Poison at Echo × Poison chance, and Lifesteals from the spell plus its forced elemental eruption. Prismatic Echo can repeat that eruption. Mana generation determines spell frequency; Crit, Echo, Poison and elemental power all improve the payoff.

passive.name: Arcane Reservoir
passive.desc: Uses Mana. Channel Bolt builds it; Arcane Lance spends it, can Crit, converts half of Echo chance into bonus damage, applies Echo-weighted Poison and Lifesteals from its forced elemental eruption.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.desc: A durable front-line warrior. Guarding is exceptional and Titan Cleave strikes two enemies while granting a barrier.

ultimate.name: Titan Cleave
ultimate.desc: A 260% cleave that hits up to two enemies and grants a Battle Barrier.

fighter.scaleNotes: Defense is both survival and, with several Fighter powers, offense. Attack still raises baseline damage, but Guard/barrier uptime and Defense scaling are the class's defining growth path.

passive.name: Counterstance
passive.desc: Guarding primes the Fighter's next basic attack for a heavy counterblow.

monk.name: Monk
monk.desc: A rapid martial artist who mixes Echo Strikes, evasion and self-healing into relentless pressure.

ultimate.name: Hundred Fists
ultimate.desc: A storm of blows dealing 325% damage and restoring 10% max HP.

monk.scaleNotes: Attack, Echo Strike and Dodge work together: every real base hit and Echo Strike advances Flowing Combo after the action, so Echo directly accelerates the class engine. Hundred Fists scales mostly from Attack.

passive.name: Flowing Combo
passive.desc: Every real basic hit and Echo Strike advances Combo after the action, increasing damage, Echo chance and Dodge. Guarding or drinking a potion resets it.

clown.name: Clown
clown.desc: A chaotic trickster powered by Luck, crits and weapons that should not legally count as weapons.

ultimate.name: Final Punchline
ultimate.desc: A wildly variable area catastrophe that always grants a bonus effect.

clown.scaleNotes: Luck, Crit and Echo are the main chaos multipliers. Clown has high variance rather than one clean stat curve; more Luck also improves the road rewards that feed the build.

passive.name: Opening Gag
passive.desc: Every battle begins with a random comedy gimmick: shoes, pies, barriers, applause or chickens.

rouge.name: Rouge
rouge.desc: Rouge—the colour, not the thief—is a crimson battle artist whose occult brushwork builds Mana for Scarlet Hex.

ultimate.name: Crimson Deluge
ultimate.desc: A 310% scarlet strike with powerful innate lifesteal.

rouge.scaleNotes: Rouge—the colour—likes Attack, Crit, Echo, Poison and Lifesteal. Scarlet Hex converts half of Echo chance into spell damage, applies Poison at Echo × Poison chance, and real Rouge drains doubled Lifesteal from its full primary-plus-splash damage package.

passive.name: Painted Hexcraft
passive.desc: Uses Mana. Crimson Stroke builds it; Scarlet Hex spends it on high-Crit battle-art magic that converts half of Echo chance into bonus damage, applies Echo-weighted Poison and drains doubled Lifesteal from the full Hex.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.desc: A battle-scarred engine of rage. Missing HP becomes Rage: every 1% missing HP increases damage by 1%, and Ragequake pulverizes every enemy.

ultimate.name: Ragequake
ultimate.desc: An area smash dealing 280% damage. Your current Rage multiplies it like all other Berserker damage.

berserker.scaleNotes: Every 1% missing HP becomes 1% Rage damage. Attack raises the base being multiplied; Max HP widens the dangerous Rage window; Lifesteal helps you hover there without dying.

passive.name: Blood Rage
passive.desc: Every 1% missing HP grants +1% damage as Rage. The bar fills as your HP falls.

turtle.name: Turtle
turtle.unlock: Reach more than 40 Defense during a run
turtle.desc: A living fortress with enormous defense. Its shell turns patience into crushing counterpressure.

ultimate.name: Shellquake
ultimate.desc: An area shell slam dealing 240% damage and granting two barriers.

turtle.scaleNotes: Defense is the premium stat: it drastically improves survival and can be converted into damage. Turtle scales slowly with raw Attack but explosively once Defense-based powers stack.

passive.name: Shell Discipline
passive.desc: Guarding primes a crushing shell counter on the next basic attack. Starts with an extra Barrier and +1 Defense.

frog.name: Frog
frog.unlock: Reach 150% Echo Strike during a run
frog.desc: An impossible amphibian built around chained Echo Strikes and increasingly aggressive croaking.

ultimate.name: Croak Cascade
ultimate.desc: Six jumping strikes that independently target living enemies.

frog.scaleNotes: Echo Strike is the primary engine. Values above 100% create guaranteed extra hits, and Croak Cascade converts high Echo into more jumps. Attack still determines how hard each jump lands.

passive.name: Predatory Bounce
passive.desc: Echo-heavy attacks become especially vicious against enemies below half HP.

d20.name: The Twenty-Sider
d20.desc: A hidden avatar of probability. Combat actions visibly roll a d20, pause on the result, and can erupt into absurd outcomes.

ultimate.name: Natural Twenty
ultimate.desc: Roll the action d20, then release a wildly scaling reality burst.

d20.scaleNotes: Probability is the mechanic. Attack supplies the floor, while Crit, Echo and Luck make high D20 outcomes increasingly absurd. Exact high-roll interactions remain intentionally undocumented.

passive.name: Probability Leak
passive.desc: Nearly every combat action rolls a visible d20. The class intentionally pauses so you can witness fate making mistakes.

slime.name: Slime
slime.desc: No true class identity and no exclusive specialty: the Slime survives by borrowing non-Ultimate strengths from many other non-secret classes.

ultimate.name: Ooze Everything
ultimate.desc: A 270% wave of slime that strikes the entire enemy pack.

slime.scaleNotes: Slime has no exclusive scaling rule; its strength is access to the broad shared/class power pool. It can become whatever the run offers—Attack bruiser, Echo machine, elemental build or sustain blob.

passive.name: Borrowed Shapes
passive.desc: Has no privileged mechanic of its own. Instead it can learn many non-Ultimate class powers from other non-secret classes.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.unlock: Exceed 100% Lifesteal and defeat the Board 3 final boss
vampire.desc: A lifestealing occult duelist. Night Siphon builds Mana; Grave Lance spends it on a Crit-capable strike that scales from Lifesteal and Echo, rolls normal elements and Poison, then drinks the damage back at doubled Lifesteal.

ultimate.name: Crimson Eclipse
ultimate.desc: Drain the entire pack with damage that scales from Lifesteal and Echo; healing also scales from current Lifesteal.

vampire.scaleNotes: Lifesteal is now both offense and sustain: Grave Lance gains damage from current Lifesteal, converts 80% of Echo chance into bonus damage, uses 120% of normal Poison chance, can Crit and rolls normal elements. Crimson Eclipse also converts Lifesteal and Echo into pack damage, while its drain rises with current Lifesteal.

passive.name: Night Hunger
passive.desc: Uses Mana for occult attacks while retaining extreme Lifesteal. Grave Lance scales from Lifesteal and Echo, can Crit, rolls normal elements and Poison, and drains doubled Lifesteal.

ninja.name: Ninja
ninja.unlock: Reach more than 100% Critical chance during a run
ninja.desc: A precision assassin built around overflow critical tiers, smoke and rapid single-target execution.

ultimate.name: Thousand Shadows
ultimate.desc: Five independently critical strikes against the selected enemy, spilling to new targets on defeat.

ninja.scaleNotes: Crit is king: overflow above 100% creates additional guaranteed critical tiers. Attack multiplies those tiers, while Echo supplies more chances to exploit them. Dodge compensates for very low base durability.

passive.name: Smoke Counter
passive.desc: Critical hits build Smoke. At 3 Smoke, the next basic attack becomes a defense-piercing execution strike.

ceo.name: CEO
ceo.desc: The hidden executive class converts extreme guardian specialization into hostile quarterly growth.

ultimate.name: Quarterly Annihilation
ultimate.desc: A boardroom-wide attack scaling with Boss Damage and current gold.

ceo.scaleNotes: Boss Damage is both an unlock identity and a major multiplier. Gold can become direct combat value through executive powers, so economic growth and guardian specialization feed each other.

passive.name: Executive Compensation
passive.desc: All gold gained is increased by +200%. Secret classes are allowed to be financially irresponsible.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.unlock: Defeat the Road Merchant secret boss once
merchant.desc: A secret trader using gold, resale margins and actual occult accounting. It builds Mana with Ledger Tap and spends it on Foreclosure Hex.
merchant.stats: 52 HP · 10 ATK · 25/100 MANA · 20 LUCK · GOLD SCALING

ultimate.name: Market Monopoly
ultimate.desc: Deals massive pack damage, grants gold and raises two barriers.

merchant.scaleNotes: Gold is a combat stat. Foreclosure Hex adds 5% of current gold with no cap, then multiplies that damage by current Crit and Echo instead of rolling Crit. It also keeps normal Poison and elemental proc chances, so wealth builds still benefit from combat stats.

passive.name: Occult Accounting
passive.desc: Selling unused gear pays 200% normal value. Ledger Tap builds Mana; Foreclosure Hex spends it, adds uncapped gold scaling, multiplies with Crit/Echo, and keeps normal Poison/element procs.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.desc: A holy sustain specialist. Blessed attacks can restore HP, Light effects are especially valuable, and Divine Reckoning heals while damaging the whole pack.
cleric.scaleNotes: Attack scales modestly; healing scales mainly from max HP and repeated actions. Defense and sustain make long guardian fights increasingly favorable.

ultimate.name: Divine Reckoning
ultimate.desc: Holy area damage plus a large self-heal. Overhealing can interact with effects that explicitly allow it.

passive.name: Faith
passive.desc: Healing builds Faith. At full Faith, the Cleric can cast a free Consecration during combat.

paladin.name: Paladin
paladin.unlock: Defeat Board 3 with both Fighter and Cleric
paladin.desc: A holy guardian hybrid. Healing stores Oath Grace; Guard consumes that Grace for stronger mitigation and barriers, while Defense still contributes to offense.
paladin.scaleNotes: Healing and max HP build Oath Grace; Defense makes each empowered Guard more valuable. The class blends Cleric sustain with Fighter-style defensive tempo.

ultimate.name: Aegis Judgment
ultimate.desc: Heavy holy area damage scaling with Attack and Defense, heals the Paladin and feeds Oath Grace, then raises barriers.

passive.name: Oathplate
passive.desc: Defense contributes 35% of its value to ordinary attack damage. The class remains deliberately stable and dependable.

beastmaster.name: Beastmaster
beastmaster.desc: A late-unlock companion commander. Its own attacks are reliable, while pet Bond, pet damage and double-pet attacks become a genuinely dangerous second damage engine.
beastmaster.stats: 48 HP · 7 ATK · 1 DEF · STRONG PET SCALING
beastmaster.scaleNotes: Gains more from companion level and pet bonuses than most classes. Pack Call converts current pet damage directly into burst damage.

ultimate.name: Call of the Pack
ultimate.desc: Calls a spectral pack for area damage based on Attack plus several times your active companion's damage.

passive.name: Pack Orders
passive.desc: Can switch its companion between Aggressive, Defensive and Support stances during battle.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.unlock: Hold 5,000 gold at one time and defeat the Board 3 miniboss
rogue.desc: A fast opportunist built around Dodge, gold and one Steal attempt per battle. Stat Heist can upgrade successful Steals to borrow 10% of a target's ATK and DEF for that battle.
rogue.scaleNotes: Raw Attack and Crit scale its burst fastest. Gold is also tactical fuel: some Rogue powers and its ultimate turn a rich purse into momentum.

ultimate.name: Grand Larceny
ultimate.desc: A brutal single-target strike that steals gold after the hit.

passive.name: Sticky Fingers
passive.desc: Can attempt to Steal once per battle for gold and occasionally a potion. Above 50 Luck, successful Steals can snatch a random powerup; Grand Larceny can also steal battle-only ATK/DEF. Starts with +25% gold gain and +5% Dodge.

bloodmage.name: Bloodmage
bloodmage.unlock: Secret: defeat the Bloodmage hidden inside a Bloodwell
bloodmage.desc: A forbidden occult caster that replaces Mana with HP. Bloodletting restores fuel, Exsanguinate spends life on a Crit-capable attack that converts half of Echo chance into damage and can proc Poison/elements, and Replenish heals both combatants.
bloodmage.scaleNotes: Attack and max HP scale Exsanguinate's blood-fuel base; Crit multiplies it, half of Echo chance becomes deterministic bonus damage, and Poison uses (50% Echo) × Poison chance. Normal elemental procs still fire from the landing hit.

ultimate.name: Sanguine Cataclysm
ultimate.desc: Deals heavy damage to every enemy, then restores a portion of the blood spilled.

passive.name: Blood Is Mana
passive.desc: Uses HP where other occult classes use Mana. Bloodletting restores fuel; Exsanguinate spends life for Crit/Echo/Poison/element-scaled damage; Replenish heals both sides.

summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.desc: A Mana-based pet caster. Spirit Bolt builds Mana; Conjure Familiar spends it to call temporary elemental spirits that join companion attacks. The companion circle converts 10% of Summoner Attack into pet damage before class powerups.

ultimate.name: Grand Convergence
ultimate.desc: Calls a temporary full spirit circle and sends every summoned familiar crashing through the enemy pack.

passive.name: Spirit Circle
passive.desc: Uses Mana to conjure up to three temporary companion spirits each battle. The companion circle converts 10% of player Attack into pet damage, and Summoned spirits attack after the normal companion.

pokemontrainer.name: Pokémon Trainer
pokemontrainer.unlock: Secret: raise every companion to level 10 and clear Board 5 with Beastmaster on any difficulty
pokemontrainer.desc: A secret late-game companion master. Six Dicebound creatures are randomly drafted at the start of every run; switch between them freely and unleash the entire roster together.

ultimate.name: Six-Pack Stampede
ultimate.desc: Every creature in the six-member roster attacks the entire pack in rapid succession.

passive.name: Six-Creature Draft
passive.desc: At run start, six companions are randomly drafted into a roster. The active roster creature attacks much harder and may call an assist.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.desc: A potion engineer who brews replacements during combat and can drink potions for healing or throw them as volatile weapons. Volatile Flask deals 150% Potion Healing + 100% Attack, can Crit, and uses 250% of current Poison chance.

ultimate.name: Grand Distillation
ultimate.desc: Creates three potions, restores health and detonates an oversized restorative formula across the enemy pack.

passive.name: Combat Distillery
passive.desc: Every third basic attack brews a potion. Volatile Flask converts 150% Potion Healing + 100% Attack into pack damage, can Crit and uses 250% Poison chance.

ouroboros.name: Ouroboros
ouroboros.unlock: Secret: reach 400% Echo Strike during a run
ouroboros.desc: A recursive serpent that refuses normal Attack scaling. Attack is fixed at 10; every point of Attack gained or lost becomes 10% Echo Strike instead. Its best powers turn absurd Echo into poison and elemental recursion.
ouroboros.scaleNotes: Attack cannot move from 10. Attack bonuses convert into Echo Strike at 10% per point; Echo, Poison and elemental effects are the real scaling engines.

ultimate.name: Infinite Return
ultimate.desc: A chain of serpent strikes whose hit count scales with Echo Strike. Every hit adds Poison and can bounce through the pack.

dragoon.name: Dragoon
dragoon.desc: A lance fighter who uses Jump to become Airborne through one enemy response, then spends the following action on a powerful landing strike.
dragoon.scaleNotes: Attack drives both ordinary strikes and the landing hit. Landing rolls normal Crit, Poison and elemental effects, while Aerial Discipline shortens Jump's six-turn cooldown.

ultimate.name: Dragon Dive
ultimate.desc: A direct, decisive aerial dive against the selected target that uses the normal Ultimate and elemental rules.

invoker.name: Invoker
invoker.unlock: Cast 100 Mana-spender spells across your career.
invoker.desc: A grand occultist with three offensive orb strikes: Quas uses 70% Echo and forms Blue, Wex uses 120% Echo and generates Mana/Green, and Exort uses 70% Echo and forms Red. Elemental Lance spends Mana for a Crit/Poison/element/Lifesteal-scaled Red attack, and Invoke combines the current three orbs into one of ten battle spells.

ultimate.name: Invoke
ultimate.desc: At 100 Ultimate, invoke the spell determined by your current three-orb formula.

slimerouge.name: Slime Rouge
slimerouge.unlock: Secret: clear Board 6 after beginning the run with Random while Slime is already unlocked
slimerouge.desc: A late-game red randomizer. Every run it becomes one random unlocked class identity with that class's real mechanics, then independently rolls one random unlocked class ultimate. Compatible class powers are offered only when the run can actually use them.
slimerouge.stats: 44 HP · 7 ATK · 1 DEF · RANDOM IDENTITY · RANDOM ULTIMATE
slimerouge.scaleNotes: Its base body stays generalist, but the selected identity activates real class resources and mechanics such as Marks, Smoke, Mana, Spirits or Combo. Its independently selected ultimate executes the donor class's actual ultimate implementation.

ultimate.name: Stolen Finale
ultimate.desc: A random unlocked class ultimate is selected independently at the beginning of every run and executes with the donor class's real behavior.

invoker.name: Orb Invocation
invoker.desc: Quas and Exort use 70% Echo chance; Wex uses 120%. They form Blue/Green/Red, Guard can still form Blue, and Elemental Lance forms Red. Three active orbs empower you and define Invoke.

dragoon.name: Aerial Discipline
dragoon.desc: Jump is a real Airborne state: ordinary attacks cannot hit through one enemy response, then the next player action lands exactly once for a heavy strike.

result.text: 🗡️ Pocket Dummy catches your hand. You steal absolutely nothing.
☀️ Consecration spends 100 Faith, heals 22 HP, raises a Barrier and deals 54 Light-touched damage across the pack.
💉 Replenish restores 16 HP to you and 140 HP to Class Oracle Dummy 1, then braces like Guard.
🩸 Exsanguinate spends 12 HP to deal 69 to Class Oracle Dummy 1 (69 total).
🧪 Volatile Flask consumes restorative potency as violence for 93 total damage.

recipe.name: Deafening Blast
recipe.tip: 165% AoE; next response deals 35% less damage and delays a special.
